dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Extremely sharp, high-contrast white linear edges along the outer webs of the folded primaries and secondaries against a dark grey/black body

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Clear boundary where the pale, finely-textured crown meets the high-contrast dark-and-white scaled mantle

other_distinctive_markers: Uniformly repeating high-contrast white crescentic fringes on all dark dorsal feathers creating a distinct fish-scale effect
